newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-CHINA'S DALIAN MAINTAINS WINNING STREAK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHINA'S DALIAN MAINTAINS WINNING STREAK.

text.p: Dalian Wanda hammered Vanguard Huandao 3-1 in the 12th round of the China soccer league on Sunday to extend its unbeaten record to 46 matches, the Xinhua news agency said.

Playing in front of a home crowd, Dalian was on the attack throughout the match, with Li Min opening the score in the 31st minute. Four minutes later, Wang Tao added a second goal to take Dalian to 2-1 at halftime.
The home team kept its momentum in the second half with Li scoring his second goal in the 56th minute, his sixth this season.
Taking advantage of a loose defence, Wu Wenbin managed to slip in one goal for the Vanguard team just before the final whistle.
The 1995 league champion, Shanghai Shenhua, looking for a victory to end its recent run of defeat, went down to 0-1 to Yanbian Aodong.
Beijing Guo'an beat Sichuan Quanxing in their away-match 2-0.
In other matches of the day, Qingdao Hainiu defeated Jinan Taishan 1-0, Tianjin Samsung played to a 1-1 tie with August First while Guangdong Hongyuan edged Guangzhou Apollo 1-0.
